ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; the visible surface is predominantly low-intensity (dark) with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in a central vertical band and peripheral clusters, estimated at approximately 1:10.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation across the lobes; a distinct, contiguous vertical white band is mapped centrally. High-contrast white circular clusters are distributed along the distal lateral and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped indentation visible at the central convergence of the lobes near the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with significant pixel-amplitude variation; characterized by sharp, jagged peaks along the entire visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the lateral margins with a transition to concave curves approaching the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) mapped along the trailing edges and lower lateral margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent vertical white linear disruption is visible centrally, bisecting the dark pigment of the fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation and irregular wear along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: The central white vertical pigmentation band is the primary unique identifier against the otherwise dark ventral surface.
